beliefs: Each character is shifted by +1 in ASCII, except space which becomes 'Y' [E1]
Lowercase letters shift to next letter (h->i, e->f, l->m, o->p) [E1]
Uppercase letters shift to next letter (H->I, W->X) [E1]
Space maps to 'Y' rather than next ASCII char [E1]
notes: All outputs are consistent with a Caesar-like +1 shift on ASCII, except space which becomes 'Y'. Verified across letters, digits, punctuation, and empty string.
